description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the DefaultMappingConfig class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package. It verifies properties like immutability, equality, string representation, and configuration value retrieval. The tests load a configuration file named 'mapping-test' and use various testing libraries such as JUnit, AssertJ, and EqualsVerifier.

classes.name: DefaultMappingConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultMappingConfig, containing multiple test methods to verify configuration correctness and immutability.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading the 'mapping-test' configuration before any tests are run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultMappingConfig and JavaScriptConfig are immutable classes.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultMappingConfig correctly implements equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Checks whether the string representation of DefaultMappingConfig contains expected class name and config-related fields.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Asserts that the DefaultMappingConfig correctly reads specific configuration values such as buffer size, parallelism, and max pool size.
